name: Storm Rage
theme: A storm-touched Viking warrior who channels thunder and lightning through relentless melee combat.
visualIdentity: Storm-scarred armor, lightning-etched greataxe, heavy leather harness, rune-forged metal plates, weathered furs, and restrained blue-white electrical effects.
consistency: Use the same face, hairstyle, greataxe design, armor silhouette, rune patterns, leather harness, fur placement, and storm-blue, gray, silver, and white palette across all assets.

starterAbilities.name: Storm Rage
starterAbilities.description: Harness thunderous fury to overwhelm enemies.

starterAbilities.name: Tempest Strike
starterAbilities.description: Strike with the force of a raging storm.

starterAbilities.name: Unrelenting Fury
starterAbilities.description: Maintain relentless offensive momentum during battle.
